我的生活与旅行(My Life and travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:艾米与欧文的经历和小计划。
Life is full of small surprises. Last Thursday, Amy and Owen went to the airport. It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike. He drank too much and woke up with a hangover.
Amy is reading a book about science. Amy learned a lot about science. The weather was snowy that day. Also, she studies accountancy and works at a cafe.

Amy drinks coffee after doing sports. The airport is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the train station. Best of all, the writer lived in Bloomsbury near the old library.
Amy hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Amy wants to be a engineer in the future. Amy and Owen had great fun there.
